summary_1line: Bhishma offers an intense hymn to Krishna, who grants him divine knowledge, after which the heroes travel to the devastated Kurukshetra where Yudhishthira questions Krishna about Parashurama’s slaughter of Kshatriyas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma lying on his bed of arrows bows to Krishna as the god mystically enters his body and grants him divine knowledge.
The Pandavas and Krishna ride their chariots across Kurukshetra, a field covered with bones, broken weapons, and smoking funeral pyres.
Krishna points from his chariot toward the distant five blood-red lakes of Rama where Kshatriya blood was once offered to the ancestors.
